tasks.title: Implement Global Patient Header
tasks.description: Create a persistent header bar displaying critical patient information at the top of the application viewport.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new React component `GlobalPatientHeader.js` in the custom extension.
2. Use OHIF's `DicomMetadataStore` to fetch patient information.
3. Style the component according to the UI/UX specification using CSS modules or styled-components.
4. Register the component to the 'header' slot in the extension's `preRegistration` hook:
   ```javascript
   app.registerComponent({
     name: 'GlobalPatientHeader',
     component: GlobalPatientHeader,
     slot: 'header'
   });
   ```
5. Ensure the header is always visible by setting `position: fixed` and `z-index: 1000`.
6. Implement right-aligned app controls (Preferences, Exit) using OHIF's existing services.
7. Use the color palette from the PRD for styling (e.g., `--color-background` for the header background).
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the `GlobalPatientHeader` component using React Testing Library.
2. Create snapshot tests for different patient data scenarios.
3. Integration test to ensure the header persists across different views and doesn't scroll.
4. E2E test using Cypress to verify the header's presence and correct information display when loading different studies.

subtasks.title: Subtask: Rework Header Implementation
subtasks.description: 1. **Fix Data Source:** Refactor the component to use `DicomMetadataStore` instead of the incorrect `StudyService` for fetching patient data. 2. **Fix Registration:** Correctly register the component in `getCustomizationModule.tsx` to ensure it renders in the header slot. 3. **Implement Styling:** Create and apply the necessary CSS to meet the PRD's requirements for height, border, and typography. 4. **Refactor Exit Button:** Replace the `window.close()` call with a router-based navigation.

subtasks.title: Subtask: Research and Fix Header Data Fetching
subtasks.description: The current implementation uses the incorrect `StudyService`. This must be replaced with the correct OHIF v3 pattern. The task is to research the correct usage of `ViewportGridService` and `DicomMetadataStore` to reliably fetch active patient data, and then implement the correct data fetching logic.

tasks.title: Redesign Primary Toolbar
tasks.description: Create a new, more accessible toolbar with enlarged buttons and conditionally displayed modality-specific tools.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the conditional display logic for modality-specific tools.
2. Create visual regression tests using Storybook to ensure correct button sizing and layout.
3. Integration test to verify toolbar persistence and correct tool display for different study types.
4. E2E test with Cypress to interact with toolbar buttons and verify expected behavior.

subtasks.title: Subtask: Fix Toolbar Layout and Styling
subtasks.description: 1. **Flatten Toolbar:** Modify `toolbarButtons.ts` to remove the `MeasurementTools` and `MoreTools` dropdowns, making the primary tools directly visible. 2. **Enlarge Buttons:** Add the `customClassName: 'toolbar-button-enlarged'` property to all relevant button definitions to allow for 40x40px styling. Create the corresponding CSS class.

subtasks.title: Subtask: Fix Toolbar Types, Layout, and Styling
subtasks.description: 1. **Research Type Imports:** The `Button` type from `@ohif/core` is not being imported correctly. Research the project's type definition structure and fix the import statement in `toolbarButtons.ts`. 2. **Flatten Toolbar:** Once the type error is resolved, modify `toolbarButtons.ts` to remove the `MeasurementTools` and `MoreTools` dropdowns, making the primary tools directly visible. 3. **Enlarge Buttons:** Add the `customClassName: 'toolbar-button-enlarged'` property to all relevant button definitions.

tasks.title: Implement Study Comparison Highlighting
tasks.description: Enhance viewport borders and overlays to distinguish between current and prior studies in multi-study comparisons.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the `StudyAwareViewport` component to ensure correct border color application based on study context.
2. Create snapshot tests for the enhanced viewport overlay with different study dates and colors.
3. Integration test to verify correct highlighting when loading multiple studies.
4. E2E test using Cypress to load a comparison study and check for correct border colors and study date displays.

subtasks.title: Subtask: Rework Study Highlighting Logic and Registration
subtasks.description: 1. **Implement Core Logic:** Fully implement the `getStudyType` function in `StudyAwareViewport.tsx` to correctly differentiate between current and prior studies. 2. **Fix Registration:** Correctly register the `StudyAwareViewport` component to shadow `OHIFCornerstoneViewport` as specified in the PRD. 3. **Fix Text Styling:** Refactor the CSS to ensure the overlay text color is inherited or dynamically adopted from the border color, not set by a separate class.

tasks.title: Develop 'Scroll All' Virtual Series Feature
tasks.description: Create a synthetic 'All Images' series for each study that allows sequential scrolling through all images across all series.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the `CustomDataSource` class, particularly the `mapStudies` method, to ensure correct creation of the 'All Images' series.
2. Integration test to verify the 'All Images' series appears correctly in the study browser.
3. E2E test using Cypress to load a study, select the 'All Images' series, and scroll through all images sequentially.
4. Performance test to ensure smooth scrolling even with large studies.

subtasks.title: Subtask: Implement Virtual Series Retrieval and UI
subtasks.description: 1. **Implement Retrieve Logic:** Fully implement the `retrieve.series` function in `getDataSourcesModule.js` to correctly fetch and return all aggregated images for the virtual series. 2. **Add Unique Icon:** Add an `icon` property to the synthetic series object to provide the visual distinction required by the PRD.

subtasks.title: Subtask: Research and Implement Virtual Series Retrieval
subtasks.description: 1. **Research Retrieval Logic:** The current `retrieve.series` implementation is a stub. Research the correct way to invoke the data source's underlying study instance retrieval from within a custom `src` function. 2. **Implement Retrieval:** Implement the correct logic in `getDataSourcesModule.js`. 3. **Add Unique Icon:** Add an `icon` property to the synthetic series object.

tasks.title: Create User Interface for Configurable Hanging Protocols
tasks.description: Develop a user-friendly interface for creating, editing, and managing custom hanging protocols within the OHIF viewer.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test individual components of the `HangingProtocolEditor` (e.g., form controls, grid layout).
2. Integration test to verify correct interaction between the editor and the `HangingProtocolService`.
3. E2E test using Cypress to create a new hanging protocol, save it, and verify it's applied correctly when viewing a matching study.
4. Usability testing with radiologists to ensure the interface is intuitive and meets their workflow needs.

subtasks.title: Subtask: Complete and Refactor Hanging Protocol Editor
subtasks.description: 1. **Implement Series-Matching UI:** Add form controls to the editor to allow users to define series-matching criteria for each viewport. 2. **Replace Confirm Dialog:** Refactor the delete functionality to use the `UIDialogService` instead of the native `confirm()` dialog. 3. **Refactor Styles:** Convert all inline styles in the component to use CSS classes and a separate stylesheet. 4. **Implement Accessibility:** Ensure the editor is invoked from the UI (e.g., a button in Preferences) using the `UIDialogService`.
